endpointPolicy: Exact equality/one-sample association endpoints are literal integer tests below, because injecting an exact PCM delay is not a promise AAC preserves the RMS onset. construction.watermark: Use actual LatestMediaBuffer plus existing observeSelectionMarkers on deterministic synthetic input buffers. Prewarm sourceframes/PCM with matched integerPTS, call beginPlayback only at actual source-selection/resume transition, call takeAudio(samplesPerFrame*4) for the actually selected source and submit that returned PCM plus exact frame bytes to unchanged program builder. getTick is the submitted frame ordinal before writing; await pipe backpressure but no wall pacing/productionrenderer clone. Record source input SHA, matched publishPTS, actual submitted bytes and observer output. Never assemble a passing watermark from expected flash coordinates. This is synthetic offline codec construction, not an actual renderer-clock or provider proof.

contextVectorContract.matching: All three exact keyed statuses/reasons/sources/windows and every requiredEvidence predicate must match after nine prerequisites. No generic affected-context exception. Preserve all actual outcomes; wrong-context/unrelated rejection fails. Canonical expected-contract SHA includes complete vectors and any unmutated baseline vector.

contextVectorContract.coordinates: windowVideoTicks are original construction coordinates in1/90000, shifted only by independently measured encoded video origin. Frame ordinals resolve actual decoded visual IDs/PTS. sourceInputOnsetSample/ranges identify injected fixture slots through immutable source/submitted/decoded ledgers, never overwrite observed RMS onsets or guarantee AAC coordinates. Predicate tests use actual observed coordinates and unchanged integer fences/gates.
contextVectorContract.evidence: Resolve every selector to unique immutable original episode/visual/watermark records and validate actual classifier facts, interval relations, full counts and conservation. Boolean rule parameters are obligations to recompute, not sufficient self-asserted attestation. Unlisted failures fail even when a listed failure exists. Retain unaffected pairs/references; no favorable early-return evidence omission.
contextVectorContract.globalFaults: Only six explicitly listed global-fault scenes may block all contexts with their exact named global reason. Postdecode faults additionally require all three unmutated baseline contexts to pass before applying their exact declared mutation. Long-tone scenes must prove real observed episode-bound failure; incomplete decode or absent data cannot substitute. No future-epoch exclusion is introduced.
